factorRatings.note: Independent Seattle pizza critic Ira Rickman's rankings (The Definitive Seattle Pizza Rankings) place Varlamos in the middle-to-lower tier of the city's pizzerias across several editions, praising the dough as the strongest component while finding the sauce and cheese flavors muted. A Greek-American community archive notes the Laurelhurst shop has served the UW-adjacent neighborhood since 1994 and is known for its oversized 'football-sized' calzones and kid-friendly, TV-filled sports-bar room rather than for destination-caliber pizza.

ratingSkipped.note: Confirmed the Pinehurst/Northgate-area Pizza Twist is the franchise location at 12319 Roosevelt Way NE, Seattle, WA 98125 (matched via Atly, Spinach, and MapQuest listings against pizzatwist.com, a Chicago-born Indian-fusion pizza chain). Found no published review, roundup entry, or news story specific to this branch -- only directory/aggregator listings for it, plus trade-press pieces (QSR, PMQ, Franchising.com) about the chain's national expansion and a 2021 Capitol Hill Seattle article about a different (Broadway) Seattle location. Skipping rather than rating on aggregator listings or coverage of a different branch.
